runner: Codex in-app browser against an isolated seeded SQLite database, backed by the Phase 4 API and security suites

cases.expected: Xugu campaign shell, project-scoped quota and an evidence-ready ledger
cases.actual: Xugu campaign terms, v4.2 facts, one local material, one ready evidence block and one Q&A grant rendered

cases.expected: Standard project terms with an isolated empty ledger
cases.actual: Standard project shell showed 项目材料, zero materials and no Xugu campaign terminology or rows

cases.expected: Visible upload limits match streaming server-side gates
cases.actual: UI displayed 200 MiB file, six uploads/minute, one concurrent upload, and 80 MiB/2000-entry Office expansion limits; intake tests rejected invalid inputs

cases.expected: Manual material creates a local immutable source and current extraction generation
cases.actual: 第一阶段战情纪要 was created, extracted into one ready evidence block, and displayed in the ledger without changing draft or published state

cases.expected: Material detail links an exact stable locator to its source text and metadata
cases.actual: 第 1 段 opened the exact extracted paragraph with stable block ID, SHA-256 and evidence generation metadata

cases.expected: Any generated answer contains only allowlisted project citations
cases.actual: Browser exposed only the explicitly authorized material; provider-backed API acceptance returned allowlisted stable evidence citations and rejected fabricated IDs

cases.expected: No authorized evidence produces an honest insufficient-evidence response
cases.actual: The isolated standard project had zero materials and zero grants; deterministic chat tests returned insufficient evidence without provider invocation

cases.expected: Missing provider configuration leaves evidence usable and does not synthesize an answer
cases.actual: Question submission showed 项目问答当前未启用；材料台账和证据仍可正常使用 and inserted no assistant answer

cases.expected: Read, upload, grant, retry and chat actions follow project roles and object grants
cases.actual: Platform admin controls matched capability metadata; API role matrix denied viewer mutations and non-member access with uniform not-found responses

cases.expected: Switching projects clears material rows, grants, terminology and current context atomically
cases.actual: Switcher navigated to the standard project; direct materials navigation showed zero rows, standard copy and no Xugu material content

cases.expected: Quota cards reflow and module navigation remains locally scrollable
cases.actual: Quota cards reflowed to two columns, the materials tabs and primary actions remained reachable, and no content was clipped

cases.expected: Mobile-first ledger remains readable without a desktop sidebar
cases.actual: Header compacted, hero and quota cards reflowed, module tabs used local horizontal scrolling and the page retained the Xugu visual language

cases.expected: Material fields and evidence are rendered as text; executable input and unsupported files fail closed
cases.actual: UI uses text nodes only; intake and API security suites rejected MIME mismatch, archive traversal, decompression bombs, CSRF and cross-project object IDs

cases.expected: No browser warnings, errors or JavaScript dialogs
cases.actual: Warning count 0; error count 0; dialog count 0

cases.expected: Reference HEAD, clean status and seed hash remain unchanged
